name: feedback-sending-hides-composer
for: The runtime's feedback-draft card while the send is in flight: the key row is replaced by 'Sending…'. Captured with the request held at a local proxy, so nothing left the machine. On a 24-row pane the composer's closing rule and mode row are off the bottom, and the state read did not name it. This case pins unknown: the session is not idle, is not waiting on a person, and settles by itself (it becomes the send error if the request fails).
redactedFrom: real capture of an 80-column, 24-row pane running the runtime with drafts on, redacted by corpus-redact; the status text is kept because it is, whole, the runtime's own vocabulary, and every row of the draft above it is the agent's and is discarded
